Definition: a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel
BiblicalUsage: Yizrᵉʻêʼlîy means a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel. In 1 Kings 21:1 we read, "And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel..." It appears again in 1 Kings 21:4: "And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him..."
TheologicalSignificance: Yizre'e'liy is a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel, and I hold that God teaches through ordinary words as well as great ones.
